about: Site types written straight as website-designer configs (feat/design-site2). scripts/dev/site-gallery.py turns each into app/ui/sitetpl/<id>.json and a thumbnail. A picture given as "illus:<name>" becomes one of TribeSiteCfg.ILLUS in the site's colours. Original to TribeCode, MIT.
